title: Security & Permissions Overview
directExplanation:
FocusByRj features tamper defense and system permissions to maintain your focus without needing a PIN lock. It includes:
• **Usage Access**: Detects foreground apps to enforce focus blocks.
• **Display Over Apps**: Direct window overlay for blocking screens.
• **Battery Restrictions**: Prevents Android from killing background services.
• **Uninstall Protection**: Device Administrator defense against impulsive deletion.
• **Anti-Screenshot Protection**: Prevents screenshots of sensitive screens.
• **Data Vault**: AES-256 password-encrypted backup and restore.
whereToGo: Top Header -> Profile Avatar -> Security & Permissions
whatToClick: Tap Profile Avatar in the top header
Tap Security & Permissions
Grant permissions or toggle Uninstall Protection and Anti-Screenshot

title: No PIN Lock Required
directExplanation: FocusByRj **does not have or use a PIN lock or passcode**. Instead, app restriction and tamper defense are managed directly through **Focus Routines**, **Soft Mode wait delays** (5s–30s pause), **Strict Mode** (zero bypass), and **Uninstall Protection (Device Admin)**. If you need data security, you can create a password-encrypted backup in the Data Vault.
whereToGo: Top Header -> Profile Avatar -> Security & Permissions / App Settings
whatToClick: • For blocking enforcement: Configure Soft Mode delays in App Settings or Strict Mode in Focus tab.
• To prevent app deletion: Enable Uninstall Protection in Security & Permissions.
• To protect exported data: Use AES-256 Encrypted Backup in Security & Permissions.

title: Troubleshooting: Why are apps NOT being blocked?
directExplanation: Apps opening without the blocker screen is usually caused by a missing permission or battery sleep.
whereToGo: Top Header -> Profile Avatar -> Security & Permissions -> System Permissions
whatToClick: 1. Check Usage Access: Ensures app foreground launches are detected.
2. Check Display Over Other Apps: Ensures direct overlay can be drawn.
3. Check Battery Optimization: Set to Unrestricted so Android does not kill the service.
whyOrTip: FocusByRj uses direct window manager overlays (`TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY`) to reliably block apps on Android 14+.

title: Troubleshooting: Why am I not getting task reminders/sounds?
directExplanation: Missing or delayed task alarms are usually caused by disabled notification permissions, battery sleep, or system Do Not Disturb.
whereToGo: Top Header -> Profile Avatar -> Security & Permissions -> Notifications
whatToClick: 1. Verify 'Post Notifications' is allowed in Android App Settings.
2. Set Battery Optimization to Unrestricted.
3. Check if your phone is in Do Not Disturb (DND) mode.
4. In App Settings -> Persistent Reminders Interval, ensure an interval (e.g. 15m) is selected.

title: Troubleshooting: Why can't I uninstall FocusByRj?
directExplanation: You cannot uninstall FocusByRj because **Uninstall Protection (Device Administrator)** is currently active.
whereToGo: Top Header -> Profile Avatar -> Security & Permissions -> Uninstall Protection
whatToClick: 1. Tap the Profile Avatar in the top header
2. Tap Security & Permissions
3. Toggle 'Uninstall Protection' to OFF
4. Follow the system prompt to deactivate Device Administrator
5. You can now uninstall the app normally from Android

title: Troubleshooting: Why did my focus streak reset?
directExplanation: A streak resets to 0 when a full calendar day (midnight to 11:59 PM) elapses without completing at least one 10-minute focus session or checking off a due task.
whereToGo: Bottom Bar -> Time tab / Account tab
whatToClick: Complete at least 1 focus session (10m minimum) OR check off 1 due task every day before 11:59 PM.
Your streak will increment automatically upon claiming rewards.

title: Troubleshooting: Why did the floating bubble disappear?
directExplanation: The floating bubble may disappear if your device is in landscape mode or if Android put the background service to sleep.
whereToGo: Top Header -> Profile Avatar -> Bubble Settings
whatToClick: 1. Check if your phone is rotated: 'Hide in Landscape' automatically hides the bubble during videos or games.
2. Check 'Enable Chat Bubble' toggle in Bubble Settings.
3. Ensure Battery optimization is set to Unrestricted for FocusByRj.
